commands.cmd: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root='${workspaceFolder}'; $f='${file}'; if ($f.ToLower().StartsWith($root.ToLower())) { $rel=$f.Substring($root.Length).TrimStart('\\') } else { $rel=$f }; git -C $root check-ignore -q -- $rel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 1) { $relUnix=$rel -replace '\\','/'; if ($relUnix.StartsWith('src/') -or $relUnix.StartsWith('public/')) { docker compose exec -T tilburg-woo-ui-hot sh -lc \"if [ -e '/app/$relUnix' ]; then touch -c '/app/$relUnix'; else echo 'Saved outside mounted dirs: $relUnix'; fi\" } else { Write-Output ('Skipped (not src/public): ' + $relUnix) } } else { Write-Output 'Skipped ignored file: ${fileBasename}' }"
